selection: All master stdout lines containing WorkNCCL(SeqNum=2, OpType=ALLREDUCE, NumelIn=3; not a full log.
sanitization: Replace process/thread IDs and private IPs with stable type placeholders.
Replace private run identifiers and log paths with run_a/run_b labels.
Preserve rank, process-group identifiers, timestamps, sequence number, tensor counts and timeout values.
limits: The excerpt does not identify absent ranks or prove the same causal mechanism for both runs.
